# Test fixture attribution

`rust-chain-simple.jsonl` and `rust-chain-prerotation.jsonl` are copied from
the Apache-2.0-licensed `affinidi-webvh-service` repository's
`fuzz/corpus/verify_did_log_proofs/` corpus. They are interoperability fixtures
for the Rust `didwebvh-rs` validation path described in
`docs/siop-login-design.md`.
